scope: Actual metadata scientific match review. Read matching, final TRAIN512 diagnostics, frozen protocol/beta, canonical final fit ledger and completion receipts; recomputed scalar ratios and hashed raw checkpoint files. No arrays, models, numerical jobs, screen outcomes or dev results were accessed.
remarks: The registered operational mean TRAIN512 candidate-pool KL match is satisfied for all three selected seed pairs. It is a tolerance match, not equality: all three residual KL values remain below the corresponding completion KL values.
This does not establish per-state matching, full-catalogue matching, statistical equivalence, causal isolation, or a ranking-quality advantage. No dev outcome has been reviewed here.
Seed24 remains the calibration/development pair, and only seeds25/26 are prospective comparisons. Successful KL matching does not turn the three seeds into three independent confirmations.

Six new scientific fits are two calibration pilots plus four prospective arms. The final six-arm table reuses historical completion24 and selected pilot2 as residual24; discarded pilot1 is still disclosed and counted in compute.
The canonical finalized ledger is root fit-ledger.json. protocols/fit-ledger-NN.json are immutable reservation snapshots and must not be mistaken for final execution states or rewritten.
The historical completion24 lineage omits explicit seed fields; its identity is bound by its previously reviewed step1000 checkpoint hash. Newseed seed/sampler fields were checked directly.
This is independent scalar/provenance verification of saved numerical evidence, not an independent rerun of the KL estimator or a live process-state certification.
conclusion: The exact selected six checkpoint files support the protocol's operational mean TRAIN512 natural1024 forward-KL match, with the unchanged frozen residual beta and valid per-seed ratios. Scientific matching metadata passes; ranking conclusions await the separately controlled dev evaluation and honest descriptive reporting.
